title: Launch Resilience Sprint Simulator & KPI Bench
body:
Overview:
This is a working playbook + lightweight simulator for sizing the first 6 weeks of post-launch operations for a new product surface (hosted inference endpoint, feature flag gated). Purpose is to drive an operationally measurable go/no-go, run a small set of failure-mode sims, and produce a prioritized runbook of mitigations tied to owners and KPIs.

Context / assumptions:
- Launch window: phased beta -> 100% opt-in over 3 weeks, target peak QPS ~650 at p95.
- Primary surface: Redwood hosted API route /v1/fast-generate (low-latency SLA).
- Baseline capacity: Dedicated pool scaled to sustain 400 QPS steady with bursts to 1k for <3m.
- Important: KV cache effectiveness varies by customer prompt patterns; assume 20-40% token cost reduction in optimistic scenario.

High-level goals:
1) Keep 95th percentile latency below 220ms for text-gen requests under normal peak.
2) Keep error rate under 0.5% sustained and <2% transient during surges.
3) Ensure cost-per-1000-tokens stays within budgeted threshold (target $0.45) using batching + caching.
4) Maintain rollback window <10m for bad model variant or config.

KPI bench (metric definitions + measurement):
- p95_latency_ms: from request tracing (console route p95). Golden target: <=220ms.
- error_rate_pct: 30s sliding window from edge logs. Threshold: 0.5% normal, 2% alert.
- cpu_gpu_util_pct: host-level GPU util averaged across pool. Alert: >85% sustained 5m.
- cost_per_1k_tokens_usd: finance cadence (billing estimate + telemetry). Target: <=0.45.
- cache_hit_rate_pct: KV/prefix cache. Useful tracer for cost savings. Goal: >=30% within 2 weeks.
- rollout_fallback_time_min: time to flip traffic to fallback variant (automated/manual). SLO: <=10 minutes.

Scoring model (quick scoring to decide go/no-go) - single-page sheet-friendly:
Weights: p95_latency 30%, error_rate 30%, cost_per_1k 15%, cache_hit_rate 10%, rollback_time 15%.
Score calculation: normalized 0-100 (lower is worse). Quick rule: Score >=75 => green, 50-75 => amber (remediation required), <50 => red (delay).

Simulator scenarios (to run before final signoff):
A) Happy-path steady growth
- Traffic ramps 0->65% over 48h, plateau 65%->100% over 3 weeks.
- Cache warms: hit rate climbs 8%->35% in 7 days.
- Expected: p95 latency stays under 180ms, cost per 1k tokens at target.

B) Burst + cold-cache
- Sudden 5x burst for 180s at week 1 from a promotional partner. Cache cold for that partner’s prompt shapes.
- Expected failure modes: p95 spikes, GPU queueing, transient 429/503.
- Runbook tie-ins: increase burst capacity (infra), enable graceful degradation (fallback smaller model), rate-limit per-token for partner. Owner: Marco (infra) + Hannah (product).

C) Model quality regression (silent)
- Model variant A shows a 7% increase in hallucination rate on a held prompt set at day 10.
- Detection: quality monitor alert (eval set) and escalates.
- Runbook: trigger immediate canary rollback to variant B + customer-notify template. Owner: Owen (applied-ml).

D) Multi-region outage (region failover)
- sim: us-east1 loses 40% capacity for 12h. Traffic routed to eu-west and dedicated fallback.
- Observables: latency degradation for EU customers, increased egress costs.
- Runbook: enable model routing policy to route only critical customers to eu-west; degrade non-critical features. Owner: Sanjay (sre).

Readiness checklist (pre-launch gated items):
- [ ] Capacity validation run (>=3h sustained 120% expected peak) with production config. Owner: Marco.
- [ ] QA + synthetic traffic run of burst scenarios. Owner: Hannah.
- [ ] KPI dashboards live (p95, error_rate, cache_hit, cost) with alerting thresholds. Owner: Priya.
- [ ] Oncall rotations scheduled for first 6 weeks, 24/7 coverage first 72h. Owner: Sanjay.
- [ ] Rollback playbook tested (flip + monitoring) with <=10m rollback time. Owner: Owen + Marco.
- [ ] Customer comms templates (beta acceptance, outage notice, SLA doc). Owner: Customer Success (linked).
- [ ] Legal/Compliance signoff for data residency if any private deployments involved. Owner: Legal.
- [ ] Incident runbook (pager steps, severity matrix, SEV->PG escalation path) added to Runbook repo. Owner: SRE.

Owner rotations (first 6 weeks):
Week 0-1: Oncall primary - Sanjay, secondary - Marco, escalation - Priya
Week 2-3: Oncall primary - Hannah, secondary - Owen, escalation - Marco
Week 4-5: Oncall primary - Owen, secondary - Sanjay, escalation - Product Lead (TBD)
Notes: make a shared calendar invite (product-ops-launch-rotation) and ensure direct pager links are validated.

Mitigation library (quick reference):
- Fast-fallback (model variant downgrade): pre-created variant B with quantized kernels and lower memory footprint. Auto-route policy tested in staging.
- Burst capacity: warm pool policy + manual trigger to +50% capacity for 10m bursts. Auto-scaling threshold tuned to p95 latency.
- Degrade features: disable long-context expansions (streaming fallback) to reduce tokens per request.
- QoS rate-limiting: per-customer token caps for partners during initial weeks.

Decision rubric (final go/no-go brief to execs):
- Green: Sim runs A/B/C pass, score >=75, rollback tested, oncall roster confirmed.
- Amber: One non-critical KPI in 50-75 band; must have defined mitigation + owner + staging validation within 72h post-launch.
- Red: Any KPI <50 OR rollback time >15m OR missing oncall coverage => delay launch.

Open questions / actions (short):
- Q1: can billing pipeline deliver near-real-time cost_per_1k telemetry? (Action: FinOps to confirm, ticket JIRA:FINOPS-66)
- Q2: can we pre-seed cache with partner prompt sets? (Action: Solutions Eng to propose preload method)
- Q3: confirm legal residency flags for EU customers on initial rollouts (Action: Legal).

Quick links (work items):
- Sim rig: github.com/redwood-inference/ops-sim/launch-sim-2025
- Dashboards: console.redwood.internal/dashboards/launch-resilience-2025
- Pager channel: #prodops-launch-2025 (Slack)
- Runbook repo: github.com/redwood-inference/runbooks/blob/main/launch-resilience.md

Notes to reviewers (informal):
- This is intentionally pragmatic — we want a small set of scored sims and clearly assigned mitigations. Please add missing edge cases you think are likely (e.g., credential leak, third-party auth flake) and flag if any owner capacity is overstretched.
- Prefer triage comments inline in the Google Drive doc vs long Slack threads.

Revision history / next steps:
- 2024-11-21 initial draft (Priya)
- 2024-12-05 added burst sim and owner rotation (Marco, Hannah)
- 2025-01-07 updated scoring rules after ops retro (Priya)

-- end of doc --
